meta.name: agentlens
meta.description: Navigate and understand codebases using agentlens hierarchical documentation. Use when exploring new projects, finding modules, locating symbols in large files, finding TODOs/warnings, or understanding code structure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用层级文档快速导航和理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要阅读和理解不熟悉的代码库
copy.tagline_en: Navigate and understand codebases with hierarchical docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to read and understand unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先读取项目地图文件，然后按层级浏览模块文档、大纲、记忆文件等，帮助你理解代码结构，而不是直接读源码。
howto.when: 当你探索新项目、查找模块、定位大文件中的符号、寻找 TODO/警告或理解代码结构时触发。

say.text: 请先读取 .agentlens/INDEX.md 了解项目概览。
say.note: Claude 会读取项目地图，列出所有模块。

say.text: 帮我找到处理用户登录的模块。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 INDEX.md 并进入对应模块文档。

say.text: 这个文件很大，先看 outline.md 再读源码。
say.note: Claude 会先读取 outline.md 定位符号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first read the project map file, then navigate through module docs, outlines, memory files, etc., to help you understand the codebase structure instead of reading source files directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explore a new project, find modules, locate symbols in large files, find TODOs/warnings, or understand code structure.

say_en.text: Please read .agentlens/INDEX.md first for the project overview.
say_en.note: Claude will read the project map and list all modules.

say_en.text: Find the module that handles user login.
say_en.note: Claude will search INDEX.md and open the corresponding module doc.

say_en.text: This file is large, read outline.md first then source code.
say_en.note: Claude will read outline.md to locate symbols first.
